summary: Steep east kerb with houses 7-13 m away and next to a main road.
reasons: Few cars park on this side

best_section.where: Usher Street east kerb at the corner by the main road

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the kerb at 7 m and 12-13 m; the only gap is the corner by the main road.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow two-lane street; no visible parked cars on this side and little room beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Corner with a busy arterial; through traffic.
drivers.convention: No parking convention on this side; a few cars park on the west side.

flags: Steep: about 6% mean grade, up to 11.6%
Dwelling 7 m from kerb at 26 m
Arterial road noise at the junction
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the north half; open to the afternoon sun over the road.
